title: Finite free resolution of a coherent sheaf on a Noetherian affine neighbourhood
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] [pqf-def-locnoeth], let $\mathcal F$ be a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], and let $x\in X$. Then there are an affine open neighbourhood $U=\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ of $x$ with $A$ Noetherian, a finite $A$-module $M$, an isomorphism $\mathcal F|_U\cong\widetilde M$, and a bounded-above cochain complex $E^\bullet$ of finite-rank free $\mathcal O_U$-modules with a quasi-isomorphism $E^\bullet\to\mathcal F|_U[0]$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 01XZ (coherent-lemma-coherent-Noetherian), together with algebra.tex Lemma Tag 00LP (lemma-resolution-by-finite-free) and the affine tilde/Gamma equivalence (Tags 01IA, 01IB)
